answer: Tracer-dye challenges: every identity gets the same task with one private detail planted in it, say an invented copper part number or an opal grade that only that key ever saw. Honest operators never see each other's prompts. A farm feeding many keys through one model context or shared scratchpad leaks: key B's answer echoes key A's planted detail, like dye poured in one inlet surfacing across a lagoon. Each echo is hard evidence of a shared operator, so the linked keys lose their stake together. Fully isolating every key removes the leak, but also the farm's savings.
